definitions.explanation: Refers to the recent past, from a few days to several weeks ago, up to the present. Can function as a noun or adverb.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}、{忙|いそが}しいです。
{最近|さいきん}、{映画|えいが}を{見|み}ましたか。
examples.english: Have you seen any movies lately?

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}の{天気|てんき}はどうですか。
examples.notes: Used as noun modifier with の

notes: Can be used without a particle when used adverbially. {最近|さいきん}の + noun means 'recent (noun)'. Covers a broader time span than 'yesterday' but more recent than 'a long time ago'.
